name: Skills Map
description: All skill files under .claude/commands/. Generated by scripts/regen-maps.js.

schema.name: skill name within namespace
schema.user_invocable: frontmatter user-invocable flag (or null if absent)

name: list
description: Enumerate every agent spec by mode and role.

name: test
description: Smoke-dispatch one agent role (or all non-claude roles) with a tiny ping prompt.

name: integrate
description: Apply validated recommendations from beta mining into the judgment model

name: mine
description: Mine patterns from user behavior — prompts, decisions, skill chains, evolution cycles

name: all
description: Run every check in parallel and produce one unified report — architecture, environment, references, requirements, patterns, system. One command for full project health.

name: architecture
description: Architecture integrity — do the layers connect? agent system, cross-layer seams, documentation health

name: coherence
description: Run the WarpOS system coherence graph across 15 drift types.

name: design-system
description: Design system compliance check - scans UI code for raw colors, raw primitives, missing design docs, and component-library drift

name: environment
description: Environment readiness and tooling quality — fast go/no-go or deep audit

name: install
description: Verify a fresh WarpOS install — manifest, paths, agents, hooks, version, settings.

name: patterns
description: Cross-run intelligence and automation proposals — diagnose recurring patterns or propose prevention

name: privacy
description: Pre-publish scan for personal data — credentials, emails, homedir paths, runtime files tracked by git.

name: references
description: Cross-file reference integrity — broken links, orphans, stale SPEC_GRAPH edges

name: requirements
description: Specification consistency, coverage, and drift — static audit, change-driven propagation check, or pending-drift review

name: system
description: System inventory — enumerate every active WarpOS system, diff against manifest, report drift and gaps

name: timeline
description: Reconstruct a build timeline from transaction, event, and provider logs.

name: warpos-applied-migrations
description: Detect already-applied WarpOS migration scripts left on disk in consumer projects

name: warpos-capsule-resolvable
description: Verify the capsule for /warp:update --to <v> is resolvable from REPO_ROOT, sibling clones, manifest.warpos.source, or framework-installed.json#source.

name: warpos-install-baseline
description: Verify a WarpOS install baseline exists (.claude/framework-installed.json present, installedVersion ≠ 0.0.0) before /warp:update may proceed.

name: warpos-manifest-honesty
description: Verify framework-installed.json reflects actual disk state (no missing files, no hash drift)

name: warpos-migration-coverage
description: Verify every breaking change in a WarpOS release ships with a corresponding migration script under framework/migrations — stub implementation pending refinement.

name: warpos-migration-presence
description: Verify every migration listed in capsule release.json#migrations[] exists in the source tree before /warp:update may apply.

name: warpos-path-resolution
description: Verify every paths.json key points to an existing path (skip generated/ephemeral keys)

name: warpos-promote-coverage
description: Flag commits in the product repo that touched FRAMEWORK_PREFIXES paths but were never promoted to canonical WarpOS via /warp:promote — stub implementation pending refinement.

name: warpos-promote-scope
description: Verify scripts/warpos/promote.js FRAMEWORK_PREFIXES list covers every framework-owned top-level directory, so structural changes propagate cleanly to canonical WarpOS.

name: warpos-roundtrip
description: Verify that promoting changes from product to canonical and back to product preserves bytes (no silent transformation through the WarpOS promote/install pipeline) — stub implementation pending refinement.

name: warpos-staleness
description: Detect drift between the installed WarpOS version on disk and the latest canonical version, flagging installs that have been stale for more than seven days.

name: warpos-structure-parity
description: Verify installed framework has the structural skeleton dirs canonical declares

name: warpos-tracked-transients
description: Catch transient state accidentally committed (.warpos/, qa-*.png, runtime/qa-*/, etc.)

name: warpos-version-quorum
description: Verify version.json, .claude/framework-manifest.json, .claude/framework-installed.json, and install.ps1 header agree on the installed version (trust order = version.json wins).

name: both
description: Commit locally then push to remote — full commit + push flow

name: local
description: Stage and commit changes locally — smart message, no push

name: remote
description: Push current branch to remote — with safety checks

name: contra
description: Create a Contra portfolio post with carousel images — write copy, design slides, render PNGs

name: linkedin
description: Create a LinkedIn post with carousel images — write copy, design slides, render PNGs

name: orphaned
description: Discover orphaned work — find every deferred, forgotten, or abandoned task across NEXT.md, runtime notes, branches, untracked files, TODOs, plans, ADRs, learnings, drift queue. Classifies and proposes concrete next actions.

name: systems
description: Multi-angle system discovery — find every system in a project by intersecting 6 discovery lenses, surface what's declared vs what actually exists

name: catalog
description: Enumerate reference docs under _docs/ and paths.reference, with title/size/mtime.

name: query
description: Query the events log by type, time range, or regex match.

name: tail
description: Tail the events log — last N events with timestamp, type, and message.

name: list
description: Browse all saved favorite moments, grouped by category

name: search
description: Search saved favorite moments by keyword across category, title, and notes — find one specific moment you remember saving but cannot locate by category alone.

name: deep
description: Deep fix — Full diagnostic with automatic framework selection, 5 solutions, root cause analysis, and prevention

name: fast
description: Quick fix — Direct Investigation, no formal framework. Read error, find cause, fix it, verify.

name: add
description: Design and create a new hook from a description

name: disable
description: Temporarily disable a hook by moving it from settings.json into a `_disabled_hooks` section, with a one-step path to re-enable later.

name: friction
description: Analyze friction points — find patterns that suggest missing hooks

name: sync
description: Copy validated hooks from this product repo into the canonical WarpOS clone so they can ride the next /warp:release. Convenience wrapper around /warp:promote scoped to scripts/hooks/.

name: test
description: Test all hooks with synthetic payloads and measure execution time

name: list
description: List recurring system issues — bugs/regressions in the agent framework, hooks, skills, .claude/, scripts/

name: log
description: Record a new instance of a recurring system issue — appends to recurring-issues.jsonl, dedupes by title overlap

name: resolve
description: Mark a recurring system issue resolved with a permanent fix summary

name: scan
description: Pattern-mine events.jsonl for repeat audit-block signatures — surface candidates for /issues:log

name: integrate
description: Review a completed /karpathy:run and merge its winning artifact(s) into main — only command that touches the live codebase from a karpathy run.

name: run
description: Karpathy autoresearch loop — plan a closed-loop experiment, review, then run autonomously in an isolated worktree. Optimize any editable artifact (agent spec, skill, hook policy) against a scalar metric.

name: status
description: Read-only status dashboard for an active or completed /karpathy:run. Shows score curve, flag counts, cost burn, and stop-condition proximity without any side effects.

name: deep
description: Deep learning — extracts from conversation + event log + oneshot retro files in parallel, deduplicates, reports

name: ingest
description: Ingest external knowledge from files, links, or YouTube videos and apply learnings to the system

name: integrate
description: Learning integrator — promote validated high-score learnings into actual system enforcement (hooks, rules, skills, agent specs, reference docs)

name: run
description: Run every project linter (path-lint, lint-*, npm lint:*) and aggregate pass/fail.

name: migrate
description: Migrate the manifest to a target WarpOS version. Dry-run by default; --apply to write.

name: show
description: Print .claude/manifest.json (pretty by default, --json for compact).

name: validate
description: Validate the current .claude/manifest.json against the v1 manifest schema and report any drift, missing fields, or schema violations.

name: all
description: Registry of all maps — shows every map, its source, last updated, and staleness

name: architecture
description: App structure — routes, components, libs, how they connect

name: enforcements
description: Enforcement coverage — hooks, gates, gap analysis, open/closed gaps

name: hooks
description: Hook wiring diagram — events, matchers, scripts, execution order

name: memory
description: Memory store relationships — who reads/writes each store, entry counts

name: skills
description: Skill dependency graph — namespaces, cross-references, data flow

name: steps
description: Regenerate step tables in canonical docs from _requirements/00-canonical/STEPS.json — closes the last loop in the step-registry infrastructure.

name: systems
description: Render the systems manifest as a dependency graph — visualize which systems depend on which, their status, and their categories so you can audit coverage and drift at a glance.

name: tools
description: Tool registry — skills, hooks, external CLIs, API services, npm scripts, platform tools

name: adhoc
description: Enter adhoc team mode — Alpha + Beta + Gamma for collaborative feature development

name: oneshot
description: Initiate a oneshot build — launch Delta as standalone orchestrator for full skeleton runs

name: solo
description: Enter solo mode — just Alpha and the user, no agent team

name: improve
description: Update preflight passes based on gaps discovered during runs. Modifies the check skills themselves.

name: preflight
description: Pre-run preflight — branch creation + skeleton gut + 7-pass verification audit. Default = full setup+gut+audit. Args control surgical access.

name: retro
description: Post-run retrospective — context + git log + code diffs + cross-run analysis, all 9 categories. Default = full. Args control surgical access.

name: start
description: Lightweight kickoff — verify ready-state and hand off to Delta. Does NOT run setup or destructive work; that's /oneshot:preflight's job.

name: add
description: Guided flow for adding a paths registry key.

name: convert
description: Guided flow for converting hardcoded literals to paths.* tokens.

name: coverage
description: Report on documentation coverage for the paths registry — which path keys are documented in PATH_KEYS.md and which are missing prose, so docs stay honest with the registry.

name: doctor
description: Validate path registry, generated artifacts, and path lint rules.

name: explain
description: Explain one paths registry key — show its resolved on-disk path, owner, kind, deprecation status, and human-readable docs so callers understand what it points to.

name: rename
description: Guided flow for renaming a paths registry key.

name: bootstrap
description: Bootstrap a thorough product brief from a guided discussion — outputs MD/HTML (always) and DOCX (when pandoc is installed) to _docs/briefs/<slug>/

name: audit
description: Active full-codebase QA audit — systematically walks all 7 failure-mode personas

name: check
description: Passive QA scan on recent git diff changes — checks for 7 failure-mode signatures

name: log
description: Log a reasoning episode — record what framework was used, why, and what happened

name: run
description: Reason through a problem or decision — auto-detects quick triage vs deep deliberation

name: score
description: Score fix quality (0-4) and retroactively reclassify old fixes when new evidence appears

name: full
description: Full red team audit — 11 personas across deterministic scanning + LLM reasoning. Finds auth bypasses, prompt injection, business logic abuse, attack chains.

name: scan
description: Quick red team scan — deterministic tools only (deps, routes, CVEs, secrets, config). Fast, no LLM reasoning.

name: deep
description: Real deep research — Gemini Thinking writes the brief, then OpenAI Deep Research API + Gemini Deep Research API + Claude multi-round search run in parallel

name: simple
description: Deep research pipeline — queries Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), and Gemini in parallel, saves reports, synthesizes, and applies learnings

name: checkpoint
description: Force an immediate session checkpoint save — captures conversation context and tool activity that git alone cannot recover, so the session is resumable after a crash or restart.

name: handoff
description: Generate a rich AI-analyzed handoff document (replaces /handoff)

name: history
description: Browse past session handoff summaries from the handoffs directory — useful for tracking what happened in a prior session, picking up a thread, or auditing decisions over time.

name: read
description: Read the cross-session inbox — see what other Alex sessions have been doing

name: recap
description: Catch up on the last N turns of this session — what you asked, what I did, what's still pending

name: resume
description: Load and display the last handoff or checkpoint — use after /clear or cold start

name: takenotes
description: Append a timestamped note to a per-topic file under runtime/notes/

name: write
description: Post a message to the cross-session inbox so other Alex sessions can see it. Default is fully automatic — no arguments needed. Use `--about <topic>` to focus the broadcast on a specific topic the user wants emphasized.

name: cleanup
description: Audit all skills for dead weight, duplicates, broken references, and namespace issues — then clean up

name: create
description: Create a new skill from a description — supports simple, multi-phase, and parallel workflows

name: delete
description: Remove a skill from .claude/commands with a backup, so it can be restored if the deletion turns out to be premature.

name: edit
description: Edit the body or frontmatter of an existing skill under .claude/commands — guided flow that preserves frontmatter contract and re-validates after the edit.

name: deep
description: "Full sleep cycle — all 6 phases: NREM consolidation, cleanup, replay, REM dreaming, repair, growth (~15-30 min)"

name: quick
description: Light nap — NREM consolidation + glymphatic cleanup only (~5 min)

name: design
description: Turn an approved Plan Contract into PRD, stories, COPY, INPUTS, TRACE, acceptance criteria, QA, red-team, release plan — then mint tickets.

name: execute
description: Execute the sprint via Ralph-style plan/act/test/review/record/checkpoint loops per ticket, with crash-safe progress, issue tracking, and approval-aware stop conditions.

name: plan
description: Turn a brief plain-language request into a structured sprint plan and durable Plan Contract. Evidence-labeled, approval-aware, crash-recoverable.

name: release
description: Prepare and execute a sprint release — final checks, approval, deploy gate, release notes, rollback prep, retrospective trigger.

name: retrospective
description: Synthesize a post-sprint retrospective from tracker artifacts — outcomes, friction, action items. Idempotent, fail-open, schema-validated.

name: status
description: Read-only status view of every live sprint — shows id, lane, status, phase, last checkpoint, and the resume command for each in-flight sprint, and flags drift between paths.sprintActiveRegistry and on-disk sprints/.

name: review
description: Design system compliance audit — read-only check of components against the project's design-system docs

name: check
description: Compare your WarpOS installation against the latest version — find stale, new, and missing items

name: deprecate
description: "Create a guarded WarpOS deprecation proposal for an agent, skill, hook, path, requirement, pattern, or generated file."

name: doctor
description: "Unified WarpOS diagnostic — runs every health check in one place. Like /warp:health but full-coverage."

name: flag
description: "Append a framework-level update flag to the repo-local warpos-to-update.md ledger. Safe to run in product repos and the canonical WarpOS clone."

name: health
description: Verify WarpOS installation — checks every system, reports green/yellow/red with plain-English fixes

name: promote-flags
description: "Drain the warpos-to-update.md flag ledger written by /warp:flag — mark entries promoted/blocked/deferred, record canonical SHAs, archive, and produce a promotion report."

name: promote
description: "Promote framework changes from a source product/instance repo into the canonical WarpOS clone. Always dry-run by default."

name: release
description: "Drive a full WarpOS release of the canonical clone from this product repo — promote, bump, regen, build capsule, run gates, commit, ff-merge to main, push, tag. One command, no cd into canonical."

name: setup
description: Set up WarpOS end-to-end — clone, install, merge CLAUDE.md, restart, verify. Safe to re-run; auto-detects and completes missing steps.

name: sync
description: "Legacy alias for /warp:update that forwards to the canonical update flow so older references and muscle memory keep working until warpos@1.0.0; superseded by /warp:update."

name: tour
description: Guided introduction to WarpOS — explains everything in simple language, no jargon

name: uninstall
description: Completely remove WarpOS from a project — restores pre-install state from backup

name: update
description: "Update WarpOS in this project to a target release. Default = latest. Default mode = dry-run; pass --apply to execute."
